profile.summary: Determined to continue growing skills in full-stack development, systems design, and software testing procedures.

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description:
I am teaching STEM curricular lessons that cover computer science and facilitate the creation of student-led projects. 
I co-lead with a dance instructor to guide about 15 girls into having a collaborative and engaging learning environment.

positions.title: Peer Advisor
positions.description: Help with creating lesson plans for the YearOne course and work with first year students to become acclimated to being a part of the Rochester Institute of Technology.

company.name: Academic Support Center- Rochester Institute of Technology

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Provide aid to students taking the Digital Systems Design 1 lecture and lab course.

positions.title: Software Undergrad Intern
positions.description:
•	Developed C++ tools that allow for the parsing of framework definition
components used by the Intel® Cluster Checker
•	Enhanced HTML webpage previously created and included new functionality

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description:
Created a java annotation processor that would output DOT code to generate a visual
representation of a state machine. Learned about the values of working within a Site Reliability Engineering team and how their contributions benefit the company.

positions.title: Software Undergrad Intern
positions.description: Created GUI samples to work with the Java API of the Intel® Cluster Checker. Worked within a team in order to brainstorm ideas on how to create the most useful tool for their clients. Also gained more knowledge in using Java language and Linux command line commands.
